record.name: Sentry
record.one_liner: Sentry provides an API to access the Sentry platform programmatically for managing account-level resources like organizations and teams, as well as managing and exporting data.

auth.notes: Sentry supports authentication tokens passed via auth headers (e.g., Bearer tokens) created through internal integrations or user settings, as well as OAuth2 with the authorization code grant type.

access.notes: Developers can sign up for a free developer plan and create authentication tokens within Sentry by creating an internal integration or on the User settings page.

api_surface.notes: The web API is used to access the Sentry platform programmatically.

mcp.notes: Sentry provides an MCP server for agent conversations and MCP access in pricing plans.

buildability.reasoning: Credentials are self-serve (api_key) and the pages document a usable API surface. (Derived from access, auth and api_surface.)

evidence.claim: The Sentry web API is used to access the platform programmatically.

evidence.claim: Authentication tokens are passed using an auth header.
evidence.quote: Authentication tokens are passed using an auth header, and are used to authenticate as a user or organization account with the API.

evidence.claim: OAuth2 is supported with the authorization code grant type.
evidence.quote: For third-party applications that need to access Sentry on behalf of users, Sentry supports OAuth2 with the authorization code grant type.
